name: nomad-cms
description: Lightweight CMS for editing static HTML sites in GitHub repos, served by a single Cloudflare Worker (API + static assets)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cms/shared && npm run build --workspace @cms/backend --workspace @cms/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @cms/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @cms/backend --workspace @cms/frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace @cms/backend
